bugs_found: cmd_all disables review-validate/review-gate unconditionally because of `if False and sub_args.branch`, so `bankcheck all --branch ...` silently skips the merge gate.
review-gate docstring requires latest overall round verdict=approve, but implementation never checks latest overall verdict and can pass with a later non-approve round from another agent.

review-gate deduplicates findings by lexicographic filename order, not declared round/order, so an older or adversarially named round file can overwrite a newer unresolved blocker/major ack as resolved.
cmd_review_validate loads manifest/findings schemas without handling FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError, causing crashes instead of documented config-error exit code 2.
load_yaml_file may return None/non-dict for empty or scalar `.banking-profile`; downstream `.get(...)` calls can crash, bypassing documented gate behavior.

contract-presence only matches contracts by `name`, not by location/function binding, so one `---contract` block named after a function can satisfy any same-named function in the file, including nested/duplicate definitions.

floats-check has large money precision blind spots: numeric literals, arithmetic with floats, JS decimal literals, Python `Decimal(float)`, pandas/numpy float dtypes, and comments/strings are not parsed, so precision regressions can silently pass or fail inaccurately.
iter_files_under_sensitive allows profile glob patterns with `..`/absolute-like traversal to scan outside the repo_root after resolve-relative joins, breaking repo boundary assumptions.
